title: Getting ready for Salah
intro: Before we pray we make sure we are clean and ready.

learn.html: Before Salah we get ready. These are the conditions of Salah – without them the prayer is not right.

items.label: 1. We are clean – we have wudu (and ghusl when we need it)
2. Our body, clothes and place are clean
4. We face the Qiblah – towards the Ka‘bah in Makkah
5. It is the time of that prayer
6. We make the niyyah – we know which prayer we are praying

learn.title: 🧭 The Qiblah
learn.html: All Muslims in the world pray facing the Ka‘bah in Makkah. In the masjid the mihrab shows us the Qiblah.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Clean, covered, facing the Qiblah, on time and with the niyyah – now we are ready to pray!
